decisions.question: FS-SB2a: M-422
decisions.recommendation: CARD-fs-sb2a (~/Buildo-scratch/p2close/CARD-fs-sb2a.answered.md). Rule text: Where neighbours exist but their front setbacks cannot be measured, the placeholder is the mean of (a) the subject lot's own building front setback plus 1.0 m and (b) the mean of the measurable footprint estimates plus 1.0 m of the lots beyond the abutters along the frontage street, up to the placeholder ring depth counting the abutter as the first lot, taken in each direction along the frontage street from the subject by following the abutment links across lots whose frontage street is the subject's (one direction only for a corner lot); if no such lot is measurable, (b) is the median of the footprint estimates plus 1.0 m of other same-street lots within the placeholder street radius, at least the placeholder street minimum, abutters excluded; if only one of (a) and (b) exists use it; else the same-zone median within the zone radius; else 6.0 m; always flagged needs survey, and never replacing a user figure or a neighbour estimate.
